Name: Shemaiah, Son of Nethaneel
Summary: Son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, who wrote the divisions before the king.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 24:6: Son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, who wrote the divisions before the king.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shemaiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
